content: {"like": ["Vickers’ performance was truly terrifying as the towering leader brought low by malice.", "Scotto’s portrayal of Desdemona was riveting and she sang a beautiful Verdi line, especially her famous pianissimo.", "The overall performance was great and the DVD is highly recommended."], "dislike": ["MacNeil overacted the villainous Iago, making it hard to believe Otello would trust him.", "The reviewer prefers Domingo’s voice over Vickers’, describing it as far more beautiful and portraying a more wounded hero.", "Fleming and Te Kanawa sing far more beautifully on other DVDs, but their characterizations are very simple, which the reviewer finds less appealing."]}
